Seedance 2.5 Flash Free Credits — how many seconds you get

 How free credits convert to seconds of Seedance 2.5 Flash video, and how not to waste them.

 

 👉 Try Seedance 2.5 Flash on APIMart

---

 Free credits → seconds of video

At the measured 720p rate ($0.143/s):

 Free credits 720p video you can make 
 ---: ---: 
 $1 7 seconds 
 $5 35 seconds 
 $10 70 seconds 

At 480p ( $0.11/s) the same credits buy 30% more runtime.

 What costs credits

 Action Billed? 
 --- --- 
 Text → video yes, per output second 
 Reference image upload no 
 Reference video yes, separate higher rate 
 Failed task no (refunded) 
 Re-downloading the MP4 no (URL valid 72h) 

 How not to burn credits

1. Draft at 480p, finish at 720p — halves iteration cost
2. Keep duration at 4 while experimenting
3. Do not resubmit on timeout; poll the task id instead
4. Download the MP4 immediately — the URL expires in 72 hours
